English Wizard.question:
১) Transform the sentences as directed:
What a pity! (Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) It is a very pity.
English Wizard.option2: খ) A great pity.
English Wizard.option3: গ) It is a great pity.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A pity is great.
English Wizard.exp:
যেখানে কোন Subject নেই সেখানে Subject হিসেবে It এবং যেখানে কোন verb নেই সেখানে verb হিসেবে be verb (am, is, are, was, were) বসে।
What এর পরিবর্তে noun এর পূর্বে great এবং Adjective এর পূর্বে very বসে। এখানে pity – noun হওয়ায় great বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২) He should not talk in this manner. (Imperative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Don’t talk in this manner.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Let not talk in this manner.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let not him talk in this manner.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let him not talk in this manner.
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive Sentences কে Imperative করতে হলে Subject যদি You ছাড়া অন্য কিছু হয়, তাহলে Subject এর পূর্বে let বসে এবং Subject এর Objective Form বসে।
Let এর পর Negative বাক্যে Subject- Noun হলে not – Subject এর আগে বসে।
আর Subject- Pronoun হলে not – Subject এর পরে বসে। এ হিসেবে গ সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ৩) He did not mean by this word that you were a liar. (Interrogative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Didn’t he mean by this word that were you a liar?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Didn’t he mean by this word that you were a liar?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Did he mean by this word that you were a liar?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Did he mean by this word that were you a liar?
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive Sentence কে Interrogative করতে হলে Affirmative- Negative হয়, আর Negative হলে Affirmative হয়।
Interrogative শুধু Principal Clause কে করতে হয়। (He did not mean by this word)
Sub-ordinate Clause সর্বদা Assertive Sentence হয়। (that you were a liar.)

English Wizard.question: ৪) What can I do if the fault is yours? (Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I cannot do anything if the fault is yours.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I can do no anything if the fault is yours.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Can I do anything if the fault is yours.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I cannot do nothing if the fault is yours.
English Wizard.exp:
What থাকলে Affirmative Verb+ nothing
অথবা Negative Verb+ anything বসে।
Auxiliary Verb – Sub এর পরে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) Had I a lot of riches! (Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) If I had a lot of riches.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I wish I had a lot of riches.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I wished I had a lot of riches.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I wish if I had a lot of riches.
English Wizard.exp:
মূলত বাক্যটি ছিল If I had a lot of riches.
If কে উহ্য করে দিয়ে Verb কে সামনে আনা হয়েছে। এর Assertive করতে হলে শুধু If এর পরিবর্তে I wish বসবে। আর verb আবার Sub এর পরে চলে যাবে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) It was a very wonderful opportunity. (Exclamatory)
English Wizard.option1: ক) What wonderful opportunity it was!
English Wizard.option2: খ) How wonderful an opportunity it was!
English Wizard.option3: গ) What wonderful an opportunity it was!
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) How a wonderful opportunity it was!
English Wizard.exp:
a+ very + adjective + noun থাকলে ২ভাবে Exclamatory করা যায়।
What a/an+ Adjective +Noun = What a wonderful opportunity
How +Adj+ a/an + Noun = How wonderful an opportunity

English Wizard.question: ৭) Every father thinks of the wellbeing of his child. (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is no father who thinks of the wellbeing of his child.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There is no father who don’t think of the wellbeing of his child.
English Wizard.option3: গ) There is no father but thinks of the wellbeing of his child.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No father does not think of the wellbeing of his child.
English Wizard.exp:
every + noun থাকলে কয়েকভাবে Negative করা যায়-
There is no+ noun + but + affirmative verb
There is no+ noun +who + negative verb
no + noun + opposite verb
প্রদত্ত অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে কেবল গ শুদ্ধ।
ক-তে শেষের অংশে Negative verb আসে নি।
খ-তে singular subject এর সাথে plural verb ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।
ঘ-তে একই clause এ দু্টি negative শব্দ ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে, যা অশুদ্ধ।

English Wizard.question: ৮) We must die today or tomorrow. (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) We cannot but dying today or tomorrow.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We cannot help die today or tomorrow.
English Wizard.option3: গ) We must not but dying today or tomorrow.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) We cannot help dying today or tomorrow.
English Wizard.exp:
must থাকলে cannot but+ verb এর base form
or, cannot help+ Verb+ing বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৯) Who will bell the cat? (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is nobody to bell the cat.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Is there anyone who can bell the cat?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Who will not be able to bell the cat?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) There is nobody who will not bell the cat.
English Wizard.exp:
ক- Interrogative Sentence কে Negative করলে তাকে Assertive Sentence এ পরিণত করতে হয়। to+verb – Future অর্থ প্রকাশ করে, পাশাপাশি বাক্যের মধ্যে no লাগানো আছে, এ হিসেবে ক শুদ্ধ।
খ- কোন negative word নেই।
গ, ঘ- প্রশ্নোল্লিখিত বাক্যের সাথে ভাবার্থের মিল নেই।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Nothing but a piece of cake can satisfy the child. (Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) A piece of cake can satisfy the child.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Everything but a piece of cake can dissatisfy the child.
English Wizard.option3: গ) All but a piece of cake can satisfy the child.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Only a piece of cake can satisfy the child.
English Wizard.exp: Nothing but থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে only বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১১) Jakir is better than Baker. (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Baker is not as good as Jakir.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Baker is not less good than Baker.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Jakir is not as good as Baker.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Jakir is not as better as Baker.
English Wizard.exp: Comparative Degree থাকলে Negative করতে হলে এটাকে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে। আর Positive করতে হলে, Subject – Predicate হবে, Predicate -Subject হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১২) He said, “Long live Bangladesh”. (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said that Bangladesh lived long.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He said that may Bangladesh live long.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He said that might Bangladesh live long.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said that Bangladesh might live long.
English Wizard.exp:
Long live Bangladesh মূলত May Bangladesh live long. ছিল।
তাই এটা ধরে নিয়ে Narration Change করতে হবে।
নিয়ম অনুযায়ী, may = might হবে এবং Subject এর পরে বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) John said to me, “Don’t conceal anything”. (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) John forbade me not to conceal anything.
English Wizard.option2: খ) John advised me not to conceal anything.
English Wizard.option3: গ) John forbade me to conceal anything.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) John forbade me concealing anything.
English Wizard.exp: বাক্যটি নিষেধমূলক হওয়ায় said এর পরিবর্তে forbade ব্যবহৃত হবে। আর forbade নিজেই নাবোধক হওয়ায় এর পর not বসবে না শুধু to+verb বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He said to me, “Can you help me now?” (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He asked me if I can help him now.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He asked me whether I could help him then.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He asked me if I could help him now.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He asked me whether I could help him than.
English Wizard.exp: Yes/ No Question কে Indirect Narration করতে হলে if/ whether বসবে। can থাকলে could হবে এবং Subject এর পরে বসবে। now থাকলে then হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Arif said, “Hurrah! This time, we have won the game.” (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Arif exclaimed with surprise that that time we had won the game.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Arif exclaimed with joy that that time they have won the game.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Arif exclaimed with joy that this time they had won the game.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Arif exclaimed with joy that that time they had won the game.
English Wizard.exp: Indirect Narration করতে হলে Hurrah থাকলে It is a matter of joy that যোগ হবে। Present Perfect থাকলে Past Perfect হবে। This থাকলে That হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৬) Sumon said, “I wish I were a child”. (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Sumon wished he were a child.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Sumon exclaimed with wish if he had been a child.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Sumon wished if he had been a child.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Sumon said that he wished he had been a child.
English Wizard.exp: Reported Speech এ Sub +wish থাকলে Reporting Verb এর জায়গায় wish বসে। Reporting Verb Past হলে wished বসে। কিন্তু এর পরের Unreal Past (Sub+ were) এর কোন Tense পরিবর্তন হয় না। এ হিসেবে সঠিক উত্তর ক।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) The teacher said to me, “Fool, keep silent”. (Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The teacher said to me that fool kept silent.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Addressing me a fool, the teacher requested me to keep silent.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Calling me a fool, the teacher told me to keep silent.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Calling me fool, the teacher told me to keep silent.
English Wizard.exp:
খারাপ সম্বোধন হলে Calling বসে।
Common Noun Singular হলে এর পূর্বে অবশ্যই a/an/the বসবে (ঘ)।

English Wizard.question: ১৮) An extra message added at the end of a letter after it is signed is called _____.
English Wizard.option1: ক) Corrigendum
English Wizard.option2: খ) Postscript
English Wizard.option3: গ) NB
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) RSVP
English Wizard.exp:
Postscript (n) (সংক্ষেপে PS): চিঠিতে স্বাক্ষরের পরে যুক্ত বাক্যাবলী; পুনশ্চ; অতিরিক্ত বা সর্বশেষ তথ্য।
Source: Bangla Academy Dictionary- English to Bangla

English Wizard.question: ১৯) The last sentence of a paragraph is called a/an –
English Wizard.option1: ক) introducer
English Wizard.option2: খ) linker
English Wizard.option3: গ) terminator
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) topic sentence
English Wizard.exp: terminator = সমাপ্তি, উপসংহার

English Wizard.question: ২০) The main idea of a paragraph lies in its-
English Wizard.option1: ক) first sentence
English Wizard.option2: খ) last sentence
English Wizard.option3: গ) topic sentence
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) body
English Wizard.exp: Paragraph এর main idea এর Topic Sentence এর মধ্যে থাকে। সাধারণত, Topic Sentence প্রথমে বসলেও, এর ব্যতিক্রমও হতে পারে। তাই First Sentence বললে সঠিক হবে না, যেখানে Topic Sentence উল্লেখ করা আছে।

English Wizard.question: ২১) How many parts are there in a letter?
English Wizard.option1: ক) four
English Wizard.option2: খ) five
English Wizard.option3: গ) six
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) seven
English Wizard.exp:
Letter এর Part ৬টি হচ্ছে-
Heading of the letter, Salutation or greeting, The body of the letter, The subscription, The signature of the writer, The superscription or address.

English Wizard.question: ২২) How many parts are there in a paragraph?
English Wizard.option1: ক) one
English Wizard.option2: খ) two
English Wizard.option3: গ) three
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) five
English Wizard.exp: Paragraph এর তিনটি Part হচ্ছে topic sentence, body এবং concluding remark.

English Wizard.question: ২৩) Tomy said to me, “What is your father?” (Make it Indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Tomy asked me what was my father?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Tomy said to me what my father was.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Tomy asked me what my father was?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Tomy asked me what my father was.
English Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ সব ধরনের বাক্যকে Assertive এ পরিণত করতে হয়।
তাই Auxiliary Verb- Subject এর পরে বসবে। নিয়ম অনুযায়ী is = was হবে এবং Subject এর পরে বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২৪) Coherence is essential in-
English Wizard.option1: ক) letter
English Wizard.option2: খ) paragraph
English Wizard.option3: গ) narration
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) novel
English Wizard.exp: Coherence -সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণতা। যেহেতু কেবল Paragraph-ই একটি Theme বা বিষয়বস্তুর উপর লিখতে হয়, তাই Paragraph এর মধ্যেই Coherence ঠিক রাখতে হয়, অন্যগুলোর ক্ষেত্রে এটা আবশ্যক নয়।

English Wizard.question: ২৫) The number of theme/themes in a paragraph is-
English Wizard.option1: ক) one
English Wizard.option2: খ) two
English Wizard.option3: গ) three
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) multiple
English Wizard.exp: একটি Paragraph একটি theme এর উপরই লিখতে হয়।
